data.name: Leilah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word ‘laylah’, meaning ‘night’. In biblical texts, Leilah is mentioned in the Old Testament as the name of a woman who was a descendant of Esau, the elder brother of Jacob. Leilah is also used in the New Testament as a symbolic name for the church or the bride of Christ.
